intervention: reader_only: reopen the same complete immutable base and saved candidate bundles from each original repeat; do not refit controls, regenerate patches, change masks, cameras, sampling or scales.
paired_policy: Sixty fresh guided-block-axis readouts individually paired with all sixty original frozen metric readouts. Every arm receives the same raw guide and exported-camera direction. Each repeat runs in a fresh subprocess; unchanged native added-curve geometry is scored separately without clipping.
qualification: Previously seen synthetic development evidence, not blind or real-capture evidence and not G1 qualification. Common readout uses only original image-guide and exported-camera direction for axial blocks, never guide position to choose a rod or native candidate geometry to choose support. Original RGB volume, complete base, sampling, scales, native geometry and all empty/rejected/error rows stay unchanged.
